findings.title: Server or Technology Version Banner Disclosed
findings.evidenceSummary: Server discloses internal stack: Server: cloudflare.
findings.remediation: Disable server version tokens in web server configurations (e.g. server_tokens off in Nginx, ServerSignature Off in Apache).

findings.title: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Attribute
findings.evidenceSummary: Cookie is accessible via client-side JavaScript, increasing risk in case of Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
findings.remediation: Append "; HttpOnly" to all session and authentication cookies.
